questions.question_en: Which spatial relationship identifies Export?
questions.question_te: ఎగుమతి గురించి సరైన వివరణ/సంబంధం ఏది?
options: Cargo movement between domestic coastal ports
Inward movement or purchase across the reporting economy's border as defined
Outward movement or sale across the reporting economy's border as defined
Transfer of cargo between vessels or services during a journey
option_explanations: ఈ వివరణ దేశీయ తీర నౌకాయానం (Domestic coastal shipping)కు చెందినది. ఎగుమతికు సరైన సంబంధం: Outward movement or sale across the reporting economy's border as defined.
ఈ వివరణ దిగుమతి (Import)కు చెందినది. ఎగుమతికు సరైన సంబంధం: Outward movement or sale across the reporting economy's border as defined.
Reference economy/time specify చేయాలి. Outward movement or sale across the reporting economy's border as defined.
ఈ వివరణ మారునౌక సరుకు బదిలీ (Transshipment)కు చెందినది. ఎగుమతికు సరైన సంబంధం: Outward movement or sale across the reporting economy's border as defined.

Export value minus import value for the stated period
Monetary worth of traded goods under stated valuation rules
Physical mass of cargo handled
